tasks.label: DSH C# SDK ConsoleChat
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $dsh = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd'; $dshHome = Join-Path $HOME '.dsh'; $profile = 'dsh-sdk-csharp-chat'; $profilePath = Join-Path $dshHome "profiles\$profile"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $profilePath)) { & $env:ComSpec /d /s /c "call `"$dsh`" --profile $profile --from-default-profile sdk --dump-config >nul"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; $workspace = Join-Path $dshHome 'workspaces\dsh-sdk-csharp-chat'; dotnet run --project .\examples\ConsoleChat\ConsoleChat.csproj --configuration Release -- "$dsh" "$dshHome" "$profile" "$workspace"
